Total time for the whole practice: minutes
The countdown covers all the questions together, not each question. It shows at the top as “Practice time left”. When it reaches 0:00, your practice is submitted automatically. A separate clock always shows how long you have spent on the current question, but it does not stop you.
  • One question at a time. The top bar shows the practice time; each question also shows the time you have spent on it.
  • Use Mark for Review to come back to a question. Colours in the palette show your status.
  • Use ☆ Star for later on any question you want to revisit. Stars stay saved, and you can start a practice with only your starred questions, and choose which question types to practise.
  • There is no score and nothing is sent anywhere. When you submit, you see a summary of how you used your time. Press Check answer on a question to see if you are right. If you are not, change your answer and check again, or press Show answer. Only the answer is shown, not the working. Your first try is what counts in the summary, and you can later practise just the questions you got wrong the first time.
